why: All five major-reviewer results (Tom's Guide, TechRadar ×3, IT Pro) are monitor guides that mention KVM only as a built-in monitor feature. None of them tests a standalone KVM switch at 4K 144Hz. The pages that answer it are niche or affiliate sites (Consumercarts, DeskGearHQ, dattatecblog). Each names one 4K144 switch, based on specs or testing nobody can check. The other results stop at 4K60. A focused page comparing 4K144-capable KVMs, with Mac+PC compatibility and current prices, would stand out.
